en: Colorized historic postcard showing a small neoclassical public-bath building with a tall brick chimney and the inscription "Stadt Volksbad" above the main entrance. A curved path, grass, and young trees occupy the foreground, with two people in long coats standing on the walkway. Behind are houses with red-tiled roofs. The printed caption at the top right reads "Graz, Städt. Volksbad Friedrichstrasse."
